issues.description: SealSaloon delivery method name mismatch: the problem statement (UML and prose) and the commented example in Main require a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity), but the solution implementation provides a static method named receiveDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) in SealSaloon. This naming difference (acceptSupplyDelivery vs receiveDelivery) will cause calls to acceptSupplyDelivery in the provided example or tests to fail to compile or link against the expected API and will confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the delivery method name consistent across all artifacts. Preferred options:
1) Rename the solution method SealSaloon.receiveDelivery(...) to SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) and update any references. Ensure the method remains static and its behavior matches the specification.
OR
2) Update the problem statement UML, prose, and the Main example to use receiveDelivery(...) instead of acceptSupplyDelivery, and update tests accordingly. Apply the same name everywhere (UML, problem text, example code, and implementation) so students see a single, correct API.
